crossRefs.note: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before…
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was…
serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;
I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.
You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.
For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom…
You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.
But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be…
those who have turned back from following Yahweh, and those who haven’t sought Yahweh nor inquired after him.
Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root, who believe for a…
to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ…

translations.web: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
translations.bsb: My feet have followed in His tracks; I have kept His way without turning aside.
translations.kjv: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
translations.asv: My foot hath held fast to his steps; His way have I kept, and turned not aside.
